name: MacXP Agent
description: Autonomous AI assistant and operations interface for the MacXP project (Windows XP Luna Blue environment recreated for macOS).

capabilities.name: run_tests
capabilities.description: Executes the comprehensive Swift unit test suite (144+ tests) using SPM and RTK.

capabilities.name: build_app
capabilities.description: Compiles release binary and packages the standalone macOS application bundle (build/MacXP.app).

capabilities.name: build_dmg
capabilities.description: Constructs the distributable compressed Apple Disk Image (build/MacXP.dmg) with /Applications symlink.

capabilities.name: run_locally
capabilities.description: Launches the MacXP native application locally on macOS.
